common-contracts.bypassWarning: Discouraged: skips every permission prompt — the AI no longer asks you before anything it does. A discoverable or callable AI cannot use this mode (private AIs only).
common-contracts.harness.antigravity.des: Google Antigravity CLI over ACP (agy acp).
common-contracts.harness.antigravity.ins: Install the CLI as Antigravity's official instructions say, and check with agy acp --help that it supports ACP
common-contracts.harness.antigravity.log: Run agy once in a terminal on this machine to log in (or agy acp --login)
common-contracts.harness.antigravity.quo: Antigravity does not report quota over ACP
common-contracts.harness.antigravity.thr: Antigravity does not report its compaction threshold over ACP and cannot take one per identity
common-contracts.harness.deepseek.descri: Experimental: DeepSeek Harness over ACP (dsh acp, developer preview, no stability promised).
common-contracts.harness.deepseek.instal: npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh (needs Node 24.9 or later; developer preview)
common-contracts.harness.deepseek.loginH: dsh's ACP needs no login; set up model keys as dsh's documentation says
common-contracts.harness.deepseek.quotaR: DeepSeek Harness does not report quota over ACP
common-contracts.harness.deepseek.thresh: DeepSeek Harness does not report its compaction threshold over ACP and cannot take one per identity
common-contracts.harness.default.install: Install it as {name}'s official instructions say
common-contracts.harness.default.loginHi: Log in to {name} in a terminal on this machine
common-contracts.harness.default.quotaRe: {name} does not report quota over ACP
common-contracts.harness.default.thresho: {name} does not report its compaction threshold over ACP and cannot take one per identity
common-contracts.harness.kimi.descriptio: Kimi Code CLI over ACP: work through complex tasks in a familiar conversation.
common-contracts.harness.kimi.install: Install it as Kimi's official instructions say (into ~/.kimi-code/bin)
common-contracts.harness.kimi.loginHint: Run kimi login in a terminal on this machine
common-contracts.harness.kimi.loginMessa: Open Kimi's official authorization page to finish the device login; this page updates by itself.
common-contracts.harness.kimi.quotaReaso: Kimi Code does not report quota over ACP
common-contracts.harness.kimi.thresholdR: Kimi Code does not report its compaction threshold and cannot take one per identity; it can only be changed in its config.toml [loop_control]
common-contracts.harness.opencode.descri: OpenCode over ACP: tasks handled by its agents (build, plan).
common-contracts.harness.opencode.instal: Install it as OpenCode's official instructions say (npm @opencode/cli or the standalone binary)
common-contracts.harness.opencode.loginH: Run opencode auth login (or opencode acp --login) in a terminal on this machine
common-contracts.harness.opencode.quotaR: OpenCode does not report quota over ACP
common-contracts.harness.opencode.thresh: OpenCode does not report its compaction threshold over ACP and cannot take one per identity
